Project: curated-list

Description:
A static curated products website built with Astro and Markdown content collections.
Optimized for fast page loads (Lighthouse > 95), clean architecture, and AI agent navigation.
Zero client-side JavaScript. All pages are pre-rendered to static HTML at build time.

Tech Stack:
- Astro v4 (static site generation)
- TypeScript
- Astro Content Collections (Zod schema validation)
- Plain CSS (no framework, no Tailwind)
- No React or client-side JS

Key Directories:
  src/content/products/  -> product markdown files (source of truth for all product data)
  src/pages/             -> route definitions (index, category, product)
  src/components/        -> reusable Astro components
  src/layouts/           -> page layouts
  src/styles/            -> global CSS
  public/images/         -> product and OG images
  agents/                -> documentation for AI coding agents
  docs/                  -> deployment and supplementary docs

Key Files:
  src/content/config.ts        -> Content Collection schema (Zod validation)
  astro.config.mjs             -> Astro configuration (output: static, site URL)
  package.json                 -> dependencies and npm scripts
  src/layouts/Layout.astro     -> base HTML shell, header, footer
  src/components/SEOHead.astro -> meta tags, OG tags

Key Concepts:
- Products are Markdown files in src/content/products/
- Product pages are generated from content collections via getStaticPaths()
- Categories are derived dynamically from the "category" frontmatter field
- No hardcoded category list — categories are computed at build time
- All pages render to static HTML at build time (zero runtime server)
- Affiliate links use rel="noopener noreferrer sponsored"

Routes:
  /                      -> homepage: featured products + full product grid + category filter
  /category/[category]   -> products filtered by category (auto-generated from frontmatter)
  /product/[slug]        -> individual product detail page (slug = markdown filename)

Product Frontmatter Schema:
  title: string           (required)
  description: string     (required)
  price: string           (required, e.g. "$99")
  image: string           (required, path like /images/product.jpg)
  category: string        (required, determines category pages)
  affiliate_link: string  (required, valid URL)
  featured: boolean       (optional, default: false)
  tags: string[]          (optional, default: [])

To Add a Product:
  1. Create a new .md file in src/content/products/
  2. Add required frontmatter fields (see schema above)
  3. Optionally write body content in Markdown (rendered on product detail page)
  4. Run: npm run build

To Run:
  npm install
  npm run dev      -> local development server (http://localhost:4321)
  npm run build    -> production static build (output: dist/)
  npm run preview  -> preview production build locally
